channel.title: The Grant Desk - Prizes and Awards, Media Arts, Film & Sound, LatAm, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Prizes and Awards, Media Arts, Film & Sound, LatAm, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily.

item.title: 1 new Media Arts, Film & Sound prize - week of 03 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Fundacion Klemm: 29th Premio Klemm a las Artes Visuales 2026
    https://premioklemm.klemm.org.ar
    Fundacion Federico Jorge Klemm · deadline 04 Sep 2026 · First acquisition prize ARS 7,000,000 (around USD 4,800), second prize ARS 4,000,000 (around USD 2,750). No entry fee; the foundation pays transport of selected works.
